title: Matching encoded query
statement: Let $d$ be a data structure and let $x,U,u,v,w$ be finite Boolean strings. The predicate $	ext{Match}(x,U,u,v,w)$ holds exactly when the length of $v$ equals $M_2$ applied to the pair encoding of $x$ and $u$, and the query language $U$ contains the concatenation of the pair encoding of that encoded pair and $v$ with $w$.
